findings.evidence: The only substantive use of `hJ` is the equality `finrank R (L.map J) = finrank R L` at lines 58, 67, and 79; this depends solely on the restriction of `J` to `L`, while lines 83, 89, and 98 merely inherit the same excessive assumption.
findings.fix: State the general results using `Function.Injective (J.domRestrict L)` (or equivalently `Disjoint L J.ker`), prove `finrank (L.map J) = finrank L` from that, and derive global-injectivity specializations if useful.
findings.issue: All six results at lines 55, 63, 75, 83, 89, and 98 assume global `Function.Injective J`, which is stronger than the dimension argument requires when `J` may have a kernel outside `L`.

summary: The finrank API unnecessarily requires `J` to be injective on the entire ambient module, although every proof only needs injectivity on `L`.
